examples.en: She received a certificate for finishing the English course.
examples.zh: 她完成英文課程後拿到一張結業證書。

examples.en: You need a birth certificate to apply for the passport.
examples.zh: 你申請護照需要出生證明。

examples.en: The store gave me a gift certificate for my birthday.
examples.zh: 這家店在我生日時送我一張禮券。

examples.en: My brother and I share the household chores every weekend.
examples.zh: 我和哥哥每個週末分擔家事。

examples.en: Washing the dishes is my least favorite chore.
examples.zh: 洗碗是我最不喜歡的家事。

examples.en: Paying the bills online is no longer a boring chore.
examples.zh: 線上繳費不再是一件無聊的雜務。

examples.en: It was a coincidence that we met at the airport.
examples.zh: 我們在機場遇見純屬巧合。

examples.en: What a coincidence! I was just about to call you.
examples.zh: 真是巧合！我正要打電話給你。

examples.en: The two events happening on the same day was not a coincidence.
examples.zh: 這兩件事在同一天發生不是巧合。

examples.en: The comedian made the whole audience laugh with his story.
examples.zh: 這位喜劇演員用他的故事逗得全場觀眾大笑。

examples.en: My uncle wants to become a comedian someday.
examples.zh: 我叔叔想有一天成為喜劇演員。

examples.en: She is a famous comedian who often appears on television.
examples.zh: 她是常上電視的知名喜劇演員。

examples.en: The salesperson earns a commission on every car he sells.
examples.zh: 這位業務員每賣出一輛車就能賺取佣金。

examples.en: The city set up a commission to study the traffic problem.
examples.zh: 市政府成立了一個委員會來研究交通問題。

examples.en: The artist received a commission to paint the school mural.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家受託繪製學校的壁畫。

examples.en: The school commissioned a local artist to paint a mural.
examples.zh: 學校委託一位當地藝術家繪製壁畫。

examples.en: The company commissioned a report on customer needs.
examples.zh: 公司委託製作一份顧客需求報告。

examples.en: They commissioned a new bridge to connect the two towns.
examples.zh: 他們委託興建一座新橋來連接兩個城鎮。

examples.en: He made a commitment to exercise three times a week.
examples.zh: 他承諾每週運動三次。

examples.en: Learning a language takes time and commitment.
examples.zh: 學語言需要時間和投入。

examples.en: I have a prior commitment on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 我星期五晚上已經有約了。

examples.en: The history book explains what a communist believed in the last century.
examples.zh: 這本歷史書說明上個世紀共產主義者相信什麼。

examples.en: The museum has a display about a famous communist writer.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個關於知名共產主義作家的展示。

examples.en: My teacher asked us to read about each communist movement in class.
examples.zh: 老師要我們在課堂上閱讀各個共產主義運動的資料。

examples.en: The class studied the communist system of the twentieth century.
examples.zh: 這個班級研究了二十世紀的共產主義體制。

examples.en: The book describes a communist country in Eastern Europe.
examples.zh: 這本書描述東歐的一個共產主義國家。

examples.en: He wrote a report on communist ideas in history class.
examples.zh: 他在歷史課寫了一篇關於共產主義思想的報告。

examples.en: She gave me a compliment on my new haircut.
examples.zh: 她稱讚我的新髮型。

examples.en: Thank you for the compliment, but I still have much to learn.
examples.zh: 謝謝你的讚美，不過我還有很多要學。

examples.en: The chef was pleased by the customer's kind compliment.
examples.zh: 主廚對顧客的親切讚美感到很開心。

examples.en: The teacher complimented him on his clear presentation.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚他的簡報清楚明瞭。

examples.en: Everyone complimented the host on the delicious dinner.
examples.zh: 大家都稱讚主人準備了美味的晚餐。

examples.en: My aunt complimented my sister on her piano playing.
examples.zh: 我姑姑稱讚我妹妹的鋼琴彈得好。

examples.en: Water is a compound made of hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 水是由氫和氧組成的化合物。

examples.en: The factory sits inside a large compound near the river.
examples.zh: 這間工廠位在河邊的一大片院區內。

examples.en: A compound noun like sunflower is made from two smaller words.
examples.zh: 像 sunflower 這樣的複合字是由兩個較短的字組成的。

examples.en: A compound sentence has two or more main clauses.
examples.zh: 複合句有兩個以上的主要子句。

examples.en: The bank pays compound interest on this savings account.
examples.zh: 銀行對這個儲蓄帳戶支付複利。

examples.en: Compound words like sunrise are easy to remember.
examples.zh: 像 sunrise 這類的複合字很容易記住。

examples.en: Heavy rain compounded the traffic problems downtown.
examples.zh: 大雨使市中心的交通問題更加嚴重。

examples.en: Lack of sleep will compound your stress before the exam.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足會讓你考前的壓力更大。

examples.en: The delay was compounded by a mistake in the schedule.
examples.zh: 時程表上的錯誤使延誤更加惡化。

examples.en: The teacher checked our comprehension of the story with a few questions.
examples.zh: 老師用幾個問題檢查我們對故事的理解。

examples.en: Reading comprehension is an important part of the English test.
examples.zh: 閱讀理解是英文考試的重要部分。

examples.en: The speech was beyond the comprehension of the young children.
examples.zh: 這場演講超出了小朋友的理解範圍。

examples.en: She tried to conceal her disappointment behind a smile.
examples.zh: 她試著用笑容掩飾自己的失望。

examples.en: The thick fog concealed the mountain from view.
examples.zh: 濃霧把山遮住了，看不見。

examples.en: He did not conceal the truth from his parents.
examples.zh: 他沒有對父母隱瞞實情。

examples.en: The students will conduct an experiment in the science lab.
examples.zh: 學生們將在科學實驗室進行實驗。

examples.en: Mr. Lin will conduct the school orchestra at the concert.
examples.zh: 林老師將在音樂會上指揮學校的管弦樂團。

examples.en: Copper conducts heat better than most other metals.
examples.zh: 銅比大多數其他金屬更能傳熱。

examples.en: The teacher praised the class for their good conduct on the trip.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚全班在旅途中的良好表現。

examples.en: The company has a strict code of conduct for all employees.
examples.zh: 公司對所有員工都有嚴格的行為準則。

examples.en: His conduct at the meeting surprised everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他在會議上的舉止讓在場所有人都很驚訝。

examples.en: The doctor told him to confine himself to bed for two days.
examples.zh: 醫生要他在床上靜養兩天。

examples.en: Please confine your answer to one page.
examples.zh: 請把你的答案限制在一頁以內。

examples.en: Heavy snow confined us to the hotel all afternoon.
examples.zh: 大雪讓我們整個下午都困在旅館裡。

examples.en: You must confront your fears before you can overcome them.
examples.zh: 你必須先正視恐懼，才能克服它們。

examples.en: The manager confronted the team about the missed deadline.
examples.zh: 經理就錯過截止日期的事質問整個團隊。

examples.en: The town is confronted with a serious water shortage.
examples.zh: 這個城鎮正面臨嚴重的缺水問題。

examples.en: The two neighbors had a confrontation over the loud music.
examples.zh: 兩位鄰居為了吵鬧的音樂起了衝突。

examples.en: She wanted to avoid a confrontation with her boss.
examples.zh: 她想避免和老闆正面衝突。

examples.en: The meeting ended without any confrontation between the groups.
examples.zh: 會議結束時，兩個團體之間沒有發生任何衝突。

examples.en: The museum has a large collection of contemporary art.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有大量的當代藝術收藏。

examples.en: She enjoys reading contemporary writers from Taiwan.
examples.zh: 她喜歡閱讀台灣的當代作家。

examples.en: The movie shows life in contemporary Japan.
examples.zh: 這部電影呈現了當代日本的生活。

examples.en: Shakespeare was a contemporary of Queen Elizabeth.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞與伊莉莎白女王是同時代的人。

examples.en: He was admired by his contemporaries for his honesty.
examples.zh: 他的誠實受到同時代人的敬佩。

examples.en: My grandfather and his contemporaries grew up without television.
examples.zh: 我祖父和他那個年代的人成長時沒有電視。

examples.en: The continental climate there has hot summers and cold winters.
examples.zh: 那裡的大陸性氣候夏天炎熱、冬天寒冷。

examples.en: The hotel serves a continental breakfast with bread and coffee.
examples.zh: 這家旅館供應有麵包和咖啡的歐陸式早餐。

examples.en: Asia has the largest continental area in the world.
examples.zh: 亞洲擁有世界上最大的大陸面積。

examples.en: The corporation plans to open a new office in Taipei.
examples.zh: 這家公司計畫在台北開設新辦公室。

examples.en: She works for a large corporation that makes computer parts.
examples.zh: 她任職於一家製造電腦零件的大企業。

examples.en: The mayor invited several corporations to join the project.
examples.zh: 市長邀請了幾家企業參與這項專案。

examples.en: The foreign correspondent reported live from Paris last night.
examples.zh: 這位駐外特派員昨晚從巴黎現場報導。

examples.en: My pen pal is a regular correspondent from Canada.
examples.zh: 我的筆友是一位固定從加拿大來信的通信者。

examples.en: She works as a news correspondent for a local newspaper.
examples.zh: 她擔任當地報社的新聞特派員。

examples.en: Please walk quietly in the corridor during class.
examples.zh: 上課時請在走廊安靜行走。

examples.en: The classroom is at the end of the long corridor.
examples.zh: 教室在長走廊的盡頭。

examples.en: The nurse hurried down the corridor to the emergency room.
examples.zh: 護理師快步走過走廊前往急診室。

examples.en: The hotel staff were friendly and courteous to every guest.
examples.zh: 旅館員工對每位客人都親切又有禮。

examples.en: It is courteous to say thank you after a meal.
examples.zh: 用餐後說聲謝謝是有禮貌的。

examples.en: He sent a courteous reply to the customer's email.
examples.zh: 他寄了一封有禮貌的回信給顧客。

examples.en: A strike crippled the airport for two days.
examples.zh: 一場罷工讓機場癱瘓了兩天。

examples.en: The storm crippled the power system across the whole city.
examples.zh: 暴風雨讓全市的供電系統嚴重受損。

examples.en: Heavy debt can cripple a small business.
examples.zh: 沉重的債務可能會拖垮一家小企業。

examples.en: She wore a necklace made of clear crystal.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條透明水晶做的項鍊。

examples.en: Salt forms small crystals when the water dries.
examples.zh: 水乾掉後，鹽會形成小結晶。

examples.en: The shop sells crystal glasses and other gifts.
examples.zh: 這家店販售水晶玻璃杯和其他禮品。

examples.en: The lake was crystal clear in the morning light.
examples.zh: 湖水在晨光中清澈透明。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a crystal explanation of the rule.
examples.zh: 老師把規則解釋得清清楚楚。

examples.en: She has a crystal voice that everyone loves to hear.
examples.zh: 她的嗓音清亮，大家都愛聽。

examples.en: We waited in line at customs after the long flight.
examples.zh: 長途飛行後，我們在海關排隊等候。

examples.en: Every country has its own customs and traditions.
examples.zh: 每個國家都有自己的風俗和傳統。

examples.en: The customs officer asked what was inside my suitcase.
examples.zh: 海關人員問我行李箱裡裝了什麼。

examples.en: Eating too much candy can cause tooth decay.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖果可能造成蛀牙。

examples.en: The old house fell into decay after many years.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子在多年後逐漸破敗。

examples.en: Scientists studied the decay of leaves on the forest floor.
examples.zh: 科學家研究森林地面上落葉的腐爛情形。

examples.en: Fruit will decay quickly if you leave it in the sun.
examples.zh: 水果放在太陽下會很快腐爛。

examples.en: Dead leaves slowly decay and become part of the soil.
examples.zh: 枯葉慢慢腐爛，變成土壤的一部分。

examples.en: The old bridge began to decay after years of rain.
examples.zh: 這座老橋在多年雨水侵蝕後開始毀壞。

examples.en: You should not deceive your friends to get what you want.
examples.zh: 你不應該為了達成目的而欺騙朋友。

examples.en: The fake website was designed to deceive shoppers.
examples.zh: 這個假網站的設計目的是矇騙購物者。

examples.en: Don't let his smile deceive you.
examples.zh: 別被他的笑容騙了。

examples.en: The mayor made a declaration about the new park rules.
examples.zh: 市長就新的公園規則發表聲明。

examples.en: Please fill out the customs declaration form before landing.
examples.zh: 請在降落前填寫海關申報單。

examples.en: The Declaration of Independence is an important document in American history.
examples.zh: 《獨立宣言》是美國歷史上的重要文件。

examples.en: She politely declined the invitation to the party.
examples.zh: 她客氣地婉拒了派對的邀請。

examples.en: The number of visitors declined sharply last winter.
examples.zh: 去年冬天遊客人數大幅下降。

examples.en: His health began to decline after he turned eighty.
examples.zh: 他八十歲之後健康開始衰退。

examples.en: There has been a decline in sales this month.
examples.zh: 這個月的銷售額下滑了。

examples.en: The report shows a steady decline in the birth rate.
examples.zh: 報告顯示出生率持續下降。

examples.en: The decline of the old town began when the factory closed.
examples.zh: 老城鎮的沒落始於工廠關閉之後。

examples.en: The city has a budget deficit this year.
examples.zh: 這座城市今年有預算赤字。

examples.en: The company reported a deficit of two million dollars.
examples.zh: 這家公司回報了兩百萬元的虧損。

examples.en: A water deficit can hurt the farmers in this area.
examples.zh: 缺水會傷害這個地區的農民。

examples.en: Each school sent a delegate to the youth meeting.
examples.zh: 每所學校都派了一位代表參加青年會議。

examples.en: She was chosen as the class delegate for the student council.
examples.zh: 她被選為班級代表參加學生會。

examples.en: The delegates from many countries arrived on Monday.
examples.zh: 來自許多國家的代表星期一抵達了。

examples.en: A good manager knows how to delegate work to the team.
examples.zh: 好主管懂得把工作交給團隊。

examples.en: The principal delegated the task to the vice principal.
examples.zh: 校長把這項任務交給副校長負責。

examples.en: He was delegated to speak for the whole class.
examples.zh: 他被推派為全班發言。

examples.en: The teacher described him as a true democrat who respected everyone's vote.
examples.zh: 老師形容他是真正尊重每個人投票的民主人士。

examples.en: She is a democrat who believes citizens should have a voice.
examples.zh: 她是相信人民應該有發言權的民主主義者。

examples.en: The book tells the story of a young democrat in the last century.
examples.zh: 這本書講述上個世紀一位年輕民主人士的故事。

senses.zh: 使沮喪；使低落；使不景氣

examples.en: Rainy weather can depress people who miss the sun.
examples.zh: 陰雨天氣會讓想念陽光的人心情低落。

examples.en: The bad news did not depress her for long.
examples.zh: 這個壞消息並沒有讓她沮喪太久。

examples.en: Poor sales may depress the price of the product.
examples.zh: 銷售不佳可能會使產品價格下跌。

examples.en: The deputy manager will lead the meeting this afternoon.
examples.zh: 副理今天下午將主持會議。

examples.en: Mr. Chen asked his deputy to handle the visitors.
examples.zh: 陳先生請他的副手負責接待訪客。

examples.en: The deputy mayor opened the new library last week.
examples.zh: 副市長上週為新圖書館揭幕。

examples.en: She cried in despair when she lost her phone.
examples.zh: 她弄丟手機時絕望地哭了。

examples.en: The farmers were in despair after the long drought.
examples.zh: 長期乾旱之後，農民們陷入絕望。

examples.en: He looked at the broken toy with despair.
examples.zh: 他絕望地看著壞掉的玩具。

examples.en: Don't despair if you fail the first test.
examples.zh: 如果第一次考試沒過，不要灰心。

examples.en: They despaired of finding the lost dog before dark.
examples.zh: 他們對天黑前找到走失的狗已不抱希望。

examples.en: She began to despair about ever finishing the project.
examples.zh: 她開始對能否完成專案感到絕望。

examples.en: Tokyo is our final destination on this trip.
examples.zh: 東京是我們這趟旅行的最終目的地。

examples.en: The bus arrived at its destination ten minutes late.
examples.zh: 公車晚了十分鐘抵達目的地。

examples.en: Taiwan is a popular travel destination for many tourists.
examples.zh: 台灣是許多遊客喜愛的旅遊目的地。

examples.en: The typhoon was very destructive to the coastal towns.
examples.zh: 這場颱風對沿海城鎮造成嚴重破壞。

examples.en: Too much stress can be destructive to your health.
examples.zh: 壓力太大可能對健康有害。

examples.en: The children learned that being destructive with toys is not acceptable.
examples.zh: 孩子們學到破壞玩具是不被接受的。

examples.en: The nurse is known for her devotion to her patients.
examples.zh: 這位護理師以對病人的奉獻聞名。

examples.en: His devotion to music began when he was five.
examples.zh: 他從五歲起就熱愛音樂。

examples.en: The coach praised the team for their hard work and devotion.
examples.zh: 教練稱讚球隊的努力與投入。

examples.en: My grandmother speaks a local dialect at home.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在家說當地的方言。

examples.en: Each region of the island has its own dialect.
examples.zh: 這座島的每個地區都有自己的方言。

examples.en: The singer wrote a song in the northern dialect.
examples.zh: 這位歌手用北方方言寫了一首歌。

examples.en: Walking after dinner can help your digestion.
examples.zh: 晚餐後散步有助於消化。

examples.en: Fiber is good for digestion and heart health.
examples.zh: 纖維對消化和心臟健康有益。

examples.en: Drinking warm water may improve your digestion in the morning.
examples.zh: 早上喝溫水或許能改善消化。

examples.en: My parents disapprove of staying up late on school nights.
examples.zh: 我父母不贊成上學日熬夜。

examples.en: The teacher disapproved of using phones during the test.
examples.zh: 老師不贊成考試時使用手機。

examples.en: She disapproves of the way he talks to waiters.
examples.zh: 她不贊同他對服務生說話的方式。

examples.en: Please disconnect the charger before you leave the room.
examples.zh: 離開房間前請拔掉充電器。

examples.en: The call was disconnected in the middle of our talk.
examples.zh: 我們談到一半，通話就斷線了。

examples.en: He disconnected the printer from the computer.
examples.zh: 他把印表機從電腦上拔下來。

examples.en: Sugar dissolves quickly in hot tea.
examples.zh: 糖在熱茶裡很快就會溶解。

examples.en: The club was dissolved after the leader moved away.
examples.zh: 社團負責人搬走後，社團就解散了。

examples.en: Her worries began to dissolve when she heard the good news.
examples.zh: 她聽到好消息後，煩惱開始消失。

examples.en: There is a clear distinction between a fruit and a vegetable.
examples.zh: 水果與蔬菜之間有明顯的區別。

examples.en: She graduated with distinction from the music school.
examples.zh: 她以優異成績從音樂學校畢業。

examples.en: Students should learn to make a distinction between facts and opinions.
examples.zh: 學生應該學會區分事實與意見。

examples.en: Our class decided to donate old books to the library.
examples.zh: 我們班決定把舊書捐給圖書館。

examples.en: Many people donate money after a natural disaster.
examples.zh: 許多人在天災後捐款。

examples.en: He donates blood at the hospital every few months.
examples.zh: 他每隔幾個月就到醫院捐血。

senses.zh: 可怕的；糟糕的；令人不快的

examples.en: We had a dreadful storm during our trip to Hualien.
examples.zh: 我們到花蓮旅行時遇到了一場可怕的暴風雨。

examples.en: The soup tasted dreadful, so I couldn't finish it.
examples.zh: 這碗湯味道很糟，我吃不完。

examples.en: It was a dreadful mistake to leave the door open.
examples.zh: 把門開著是個糟糕的錯誤。

examples.en: The long drought left the reservoir almost empty.
examples.zh: 長期乾旱讓水庫幾乎見底。

examples.en: Farmers worry about drought during the summer months.
examples.zh: 農民在夏季擔心旱災。

examples.en: The government asked people to save water during the drought.
examples.zh: 乾旱期間，政府呼籲民眾節約用水。

senses.zh: 精心製作的；複雜的；詳盡的

examples.en: They prepared an elaborate dinner for the guests.
examples.zh: 他們為客人準備了一頓精心製作的晚餐。

examples.en: The students made an elaborate model of the solar system.
examples.zh: 學生們做了一個精細的太陽系模型。

examples.en: She gave an elaborate plan for the school trip.
examples.zh: 她針對校外教學提出一份詳盡的計畫。

examples.en: Could you elaborate on your idea a little more?
examples.zh: 你可以再詳細說明一下你的想法嗎？

examples.en: The manager elaborated on the new rules at the meeting.
examples.zh: 經理在會議上詳細說明了新規定。

examples.en: He refused to elaborate on why he left the company.
examples.zh: 他拒絕詳細說明自己為何離開公司。

examples.en: He started a small enterprise selling handmade bags online.
examples.zh: 他創辦了一家在網路上販售手工包包的小企業。

examples.en: The new enterprise created over fifty jobs in the town.
examples.zh: 這項新事業為小鎮創造了五十多個工作機會。

examples.en: Her enterprise and hard work helped the shop succeed.
examples.zh: 她的進取心與努力幫助這家店成功。

examples.en: The students were enthusiastic about the school trip.
examples.zh: 學生們對校外教學興致勃勃。

examples.en: She gave an enthusiastic speech at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 她在開幕典禮上發表了熱情洋溢的演說。

examples.en: Our new teacher is enthusiastic about teaching science.
examples.zh: 我們的新老師熱衷於教自然科學。

senses.zh: 使有權利；給予資格；為…命名

examples.en: This card entitles you to a free drink every Friday.
examples.zh: 這張卡讓你每週五都能免費領一杯飲料。

examples.en: Every member is entitled to vote at the meeting.
examples.zh: 每位成員都有權在會議上投票。

examples.en: The author entitled her first book Summer Rain.
examples.zh: 作者把她的第一本書命名為《夏雨》。
